rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=12, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=8000, naf_lr=0.01, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=800, naf_per_scene_s=60.0, naf_encoding=hash, seed=42, rationale=iter-11 breast-ct-claude-agentic-naf-search-20260703-01 (redone breast split train3600/val200/test200 seed20260703; val_n=12 CONSTANT for iters 2-20 per coordinator budget intervention 2026-07-05 -- first-12 of the 200-case breast val split, deterministic).
